title: Occupancy of a building or part of a building under construction: when occupancy may be allowed
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 and NFC(AE) 2023 (National Fire Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: January 2025 (platform created January 31, 2025, last updated February 25, 2025)

facts.text: The bulletin gives guidance on when occupancy of a building under construction may be allowed.
NBC(AE) Division C Sentence 2.2.11.1.(1) allows the AHJ to issue an occupancy permit for a portion of a building before construction is finished.

All building services, including fire-safety, boilers, elevating devices, gas, plumbing, mechanical and electrical systems, must be considered when deciding the provisions needed to safeguard occupants.
Provisions for occupants and workers in buildings under construction must be adapted to the satisfaction of the fire and building AHJs.
